title: 2x Faster Time to First Meeting: How JumpCloud Scaled Sales Training
summary: How JumpCloud ran 580 AI roleplays in four weeks and got new reps to their first meeting 2x faster with Hyperbound.
body_markdown:
## At a glance


> “AI tools shouldn’t be a solution in search of a problem.”


John Milne, Director of Global Sales Enablement


The problem


## Manual roleplays didn’t scale


Before AI roleplays, enablement at JumpCloud was manual. If a new group of BDRs was onboarding, John would build the entire roleplay scenario and rubric himself.


1. 01


Each roleplay required nearly an hour of enablement time.


2. 02


Practice volume was limited by calendar space.


3. 03


Feedback consistency depended on who was delivering it.


Hiring was accelerating, but practice volume wasn’t. Reps were learning frameworks; they just weren’t getting enough repetition before stepping into live conversations. The constraint wasn’t content. It was capacity.


> “There is value in that personal connection and one-on-one feedback. But as our team got bigger, we couldn’t continue to scale that.”


John Milne, Director of Global Sales Enablement


The solution


## Practice built into onboarding


Rather than rolling it out broadly, JumpCloud began with a focused pilot of roughly 30 seats tied directly to BDR onboarding. It was embedded into call academy, objection-handling frameworks, and certification test-outs.


01


Use case


Practice


### Standardized, scalable practice


Before Hyperbound, a single roleplay typically required about one hour of enablement time between the mock call and coaching conversation. Running just one session for each of JumpCloud’s 90 reps would take 11 full workdays.


In a recent four-week period, JumpCloud reps completed 580 roleplays inside Hyperbound, roughly 145 practice sessions per week. Because those sessions happen asynchronously, reps can rehearse key conversations continuously while enablement leaders focus their time on higher-impact coaching.


02


Use case


Practice


### Supporting new SKUs and buyer personas


JumpCloud frequently introduces new products and buyer personas. When launching a new security and compliance SKU, they created a Chief Information Security Officer bot.


Hyperbound gave tenured Account Managers structured rehearsal before live execution.


> “That was super effective. We got good feedback from the reps that it was a helpful and worthy time spent.”


John Milne, Director of Global Sales Enablement


03


Use case


Practice


### Enabling new outreach motions


JumpCloud also launched a “warm bounding” initiative: re-engaging older inbound leads who hadn’t booked meetings. These conversations required stronger objection handling and more proactive pitching.


Formal conversion analysis is ongoing, but the early feedback is encouraging.


> “We’ve built out some warm bounding talk tracks. We’ve run training on how to use the script. And now they practice and get scores and feedback in Hyperbound.”


John Milne, Director of Global Sales Enablement


04


Use case


Practice


### Reclaiming enablement capacity


With fewer hours spent manually running roleplays, enablement leaders could focus elsewhere. One recent initiative: a Sales Skill Career Accelerator program to help SDRs build the skills necessary to get promoted into AE or AM roles.


1. Manual training


1 roleplay per hour, 11+ workdays for 90 reps


2. With Hyperbound


580 roleplays in 4 weeks


3. Result


~145 roleplays a week, continuously


> “If Troy Johnson, my XDR Enablement Program Manager, had been conducting numerous manual roleplays, he likely would not have had time to build this new career and sales skills accelerator program.”


John Milne, Director of Global Sales Enablement


Hyperbound’s impact


## 2x faster time to first meeting


The four new hires who did the most Hyperbound practice were also the fastest to first meeting. That cohort averaged about 4.8 days, against a global average of about 9.


> “We just did a midterm contract change and bought more seats. We have 90 now.”


John Milne, Director of Global Sales Enablement


No one is claiming that practice volume alone determines ramp speed. But in this cohort, the pattern was clear: reps who practiced more, ramped faster.


After the initial pilot, JumpCloud made a mid-contract decision to expand from 30 to 90 seats. The expansion lets them roll out seats to all BDRs and SDRs, provide 90-day access for new GTM hires, and rotate seats quarterly across AE, AM, and CSM roles.


> “We’re going to move those seats around so that Hyperbound goes lockstep with training and coaching initiatives.”


John Milne, Director of Global Sales Enablement
